description: One-shot recovery op: ensures the lot campfire for lot_id exists with the owner admitted as creator and a beacon file written. Idempotent — safe to call multiple times. Use when the async lot-cf creation in purchase-lot failed (a .beacon.err file exists in the beacon dir). Returns the campfire_id on success.

args.name: lot_id
args.description: The server-assigned FSO lot_id (fso_lots.lot_id). NOT the packed tile coordinate. Obtained from the lot_id field in the purchase-lot success response.

common_mistakes: lot_id is the server-assigned integer (from purchase-lot response), NOT the packed tile coordinate (target_lot_location).
This op is idempotent — calling it when the lot campfire already exists is a no-op.
If the beacon dir does not exist it is created automatically; no manual mkdir needed.
